note_zh: 補上商轉年 2012（待確認）：STEG 的 Bizerte 風場共 143 部風機、分在 Metline 與 Kchabta 兩處，約 190 MW；2019 年 TAP 報導說 Metline-Kchabta 風場「2012 年設置」，Metline 站有 72 部、95 MW
note_en: Commissioning year 2012 (to be confirmed): STEG’s Bizerte farm has 143 turbines on two sites, Metline and Kchabta, about 190 MW; a 2019 TAP report says the Metline-Kchabta farm was “set up in 2012”, with 72 turbines and 95 MW at Metline
why: Not written: the farm was built in two stages (120 MW / 91 turbines, then 26 more turbines per site), so each site’s full capacity is the extension year. The site’s own IRENA series for Tunisia rises 54 → 173 (2012) → 200 (2013) → 233 (2014) → 240 (2015) MW, which suggests the extension was finished 2013–2015, not 2012. No STEG annual report or extension commissioning notice found; thewindpower leaves the date blank.

note_zh: 這些風場沒有找到可引用的商轉年
note_en: No quotable commissioning year found for these farms
why: Leads only: Zopowy — Iberdrola bought it (with Korytnica I) from CEE Equity Partners in 2021, GlobalData says commissioned 2014 (not primary). Ronica — European Energy/VisaVento, thewindpower 55.35 MW / 18 turbines, no date; EE’s 2025 sale of six West Pomeranian farms (commissioned 2021–2023) does not name them. Ventus Nord-2 — Verbund’s Casimcea complex (226 MW) was half connected in June 2013 and finished by early 2014 at the latest; no split by park. Strepeikiu — may overlap Pagėgiai 13 (Amberwind, opened 16 June 2016, 73.5 MW, already in the data as 74 MW 2016); thewindpower lists Strepeikiu separately at 50 MW, so not resolved. Udbyneder — Randers municipality (2017) mentions an existing 30-turbine farm at Overgaard near Udbyneder; no year. Plaine Sophie — 29.4 MW Suzlon/PADCO plant was due Sept–Oct 2017 (Ecofin 2016); no confirmation it was built. Chimay — GEM phases 10 + 14 MW at Baileux (Ventient); press dates not found. Plateau de Bourcy — 7 × Fuhrländer 2.5 MW (17.5 MW). Cameroon 100 MW “operating” — the site’s IRENA series has no wind capacity for Cameroon at all, so the row is probably a GEM error (status), but no quotable source was fetched. Tsuno — the NEDO Miyazaki page (to March 2018) shows only a 16 MW 2016 farm at Gokase; the GEM point (32.611 N, 131.715 E) is not in Tsuno town. Others: nothing found in 1–2 searches.
